title: Death saves
stabilizeHint: A success on first aid (DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine)) or a spell like Spare the Dying stabilizes the character.
stableHint: It makes no death saves. After 1d4 hours it regains 1 hit point.
knockedOutHint: Someone else can give first aid: a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check ends the knock-out.
deadHint: A revival brings it back with the hit points the spell gives.
stillDead: Exhaustion is still at its highest level: the character is still dead.
